metadata.title: K-unstable Toric Varieties and Secondary Polytopes
metadata.abstract: For K-unstable toric varieties, Székelyhidi's optimal test-function $\Theta_{P}$ is a mysterious concave function over the moment polytope $P$, which gives the maximal destabilizer for K-stability, and encodes the limiting behavior of the divergent Calabi flow. As balanced norms quantize cscK metrics, we show that $\Theta_{P}$ can be quantized by the maximal destabilizers for Chow-stability, which are given by the shortest GKZ vectors, i.e., the least norm point on the secondary polytope for the set $P\cap k^{-1}\mathbb{Z}^{n}$. Properties and algorithm for general sGKZ vectors are given. Our result may provide a new method to detect the K-unstability of toric varieties.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: K-不稳定 toric 簇的 secondary polytope
analysis.workSummary: 用 Chow 最大 destabilizer 与 secondary polytope 的最短 GKZ 向量量化 Székelyhidi 的最优 test-function，并给 generalized GKZ 的性质与算法。
analysis.breakthrough: 将难以描述的最优 destabilizer 联系到有限维多面体计算。
analysis.limitations: 算法对 K-不稳定检测是潜在方法，摘要不声称普适有效复杂度界。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 GPT、Gemini 辅助构造 minimizer convergence 和附录 Riemann-sum expansion (A.2) 的证明；sGKZ 程序由 GPT 5.6 建立，另经 SageMath 测试。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.05179v1 · PDF 第 6 页，AI disclosure
